name: veterinary_clinic_system_016_boarding_stay_invoice_draft
instruction: Check out every guest whose stay ends on or before the episode date and bill the stay — this is what the front desk does at pick-up. For each checked_in reservation with check_out <= episode date: (1) set the reservation status to 'checked_out'; (2) create a draft invoice for the owner with invoice_number 'INV-B<batch_code>-<reservation_id>' (batch code from ops_meta), owner_id and patient_id from the reservation, location_id from the reservation, issued_date and due_date both on the episode date (due = issued + 21 days, standard net-21 — verify the convention if unsure), line_items=[{description: 'Boarding (<N> nights - <run_type>)', quantity: <N>, unit_price: <BOARD-NIGHT price from that location's fee schedule>}], total_amount=<N*price>, amount_paid=0, status='draft'. N = nights = days between check_in and check_out. Do not free the runs (housekeeping handles that separately) and do not touch paid invoices.

success_criteria.summary: From snapshot: checked_in reservations with dp(check_out)<=ep. For each: assert status=='checked_out' and exactly one invoice with exact invoice_number (live nonce), correct owner/patient/location, N==days(dp(check_in),dp(check_out)), unit_price==snapshot fee_schedule BOARD-NIGHT price for that location, totals in cents, status draft. Assert no other invoice rows added/changed (count == 26+E) and all paid invoices unchanged.
